upstream.description: 🕷️ An adaptive Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl!

classification.analysis: Scrapling is a high-throughput, adaptive Python web-scraping framework combining fast static/dynamic/stealth fetchers that bypass anti-bot systems like Cloudflare Turnstile out of the box, a parser that automatically relocates CSS/XPath selectors when a site's HTML structure changes, and a Spider framework for concurrent, resumable, proxy-rotating crawls whose speed adapts to how a target site responds. It ships a CLI and interactive shell, an MCP server plus a bundled AI-agent skill for LLM-driven scraping and RAG-building, and Scrapy-compatible response objects for easy migration. It targets Python developers building scrapers, crawlers, and AI data-collection pipelines who need resilience against site changes and anti-bot defenses without hand-rolling browser automation; a very large, actively maintained, trending project.

use_cases.title: Scrape a site behind Cloudflare or other anti-bot protection with a stealth fetcher
Keep scrapers working automatically when a site's HTML structure changes
Run a concurrent, resumable, proxy-rotating crawl at scale
Give an LLM agent an MCP server or skill to scrape pages on its own
